title: Ablation and nested camp-size diagnostics
population: Ablation and nested-training results from the same public synthetic generator, evaluated on the same three fixed roots.
metric: Mean six-cell NRMSE; panel A shows root values and means, panel B shows root-specific nested-camp scores.
grouping: Model variant × root; nested training sets contain 24, 48, or 96 camps and use the full-data-selected alpha.
sample_sizes: Three evaluation roots; each has 16 camps. Training subset sizes are 24/48/96 camps.
uncertainty: No interval; root-specific diagnostics are descriptive and do not identify causal feature effects or athlete sample efficiency.
caption_tex: Recorded ablation and nested-camp comparisons. Panel A shows the three evaluation-root values and their mean for full ridge regression and variants without prior history, current exposure, or participant context. The structured comparator without prior history is shown as a separate diagnostic. Panel B shows root-specific scores for ridge regression and the structured comparator trained on nested subsets of 24, 48, or 96 camps; the regularization parameter selected on the full training and development data was held fixed. All values are dimensionless six-cell NRMSE within the same synthetic generator. No confidence intervals are shown; these comparisons do not isolate causal feature effects or estimate athlete-level sample efficiency.
